answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to bonded collateral in an escrow, so creating aliases does not create free voting power. When k coordinated identities equivocate, verifiable pairwise evidence triggers penalties scaling as O(k²), while asymmetric depreciation compounds losses across the swarm. A beacon may expose the coordination; detection then applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, making a sparrow-sized operator’s attempt to grow a sybil spiral economically dangerous.
